title: A criterion for injectivity of a sheaf of abelian groups
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file injectives.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma gives a criterion for a sheaf of abelian groups to be injective, namely that morphisms out of subsheaves of the standard objects always extend (statement lines 1017-1025). The proof is a complete argument: starting from an extension problem, the author enlarges the domain by adding the image of a morphism from a standard object, computing the restriction on the intersection of the two subsheaves (proof lines 1027-1052) and gluing the two morphisms there by the sheaf axioms to obtain an extension to a strictly larger subsheaf (proof lines 1052-1055), so that the process terminates and the extension property, hence injectivity, follows. The non-formal content is the gluing step. The claim is H2.
